prepSteps.title: Install the Entro GitHub App
prepSteps.instruction: From Entro Add New Account → GitHub Cloud - New, choose Install on GitHub Organization, pick the org or repos, and approve the App permissions. Entro redirects back after install.
prepSteps.evidence: GitHub Organization Settings → GitHub Apps lists the Entro app as installed

uncataloged.evidence: GitHub Organization Settings → GitHub Apps lists the Entro app as installed

prepSteps.title: Create a GitHub PAT for Entro
prepSteps.instruction: In GitHub Settings → Developer settings, create a fine-grained token (preferred) or classic token with Entro's documented read scopes, no expiration if policy allows, and store it in the operator vault.

prepSteps.title: Grant Entro IAM S3 read on the streaming bucket
prepSteps.instruction: On the Entro IAM role in the AWS account that hosts the GitHub audit-log bucket, attach s3:ListBucket and s3:GetObject for that bucket.
prepSteps.evidence: The Entro IAM role can list and get objects on the streaming bucket

prepSteps.title: Record the S3 bucket name
prepSteps.instruction: After GitHub Enterprise audit log streaming to Amazon S3 is configured, record the bucket name for the Entro form.
prepSteps.evidence: The bucket name is recorded and head-bucket succeeds
